meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把技术性内容用大白话讲清楚,按谁、什么、为什么等几个方面逐条拆解,产出通俗易懂的解释。
howto.when: 当你觉得某段内容太专业、想要一份大白话拆解时触发;技能说明写明的条件是「用户想要对某个技术内容做通俗解释」。

say.text: 用大白话讲讲这段内容是什么
say.note: 它会按几个方面逐条拆解

say.text: 这个报错到底在说什么,讲简单点
say.note: 输出通俗解释,不用术语

say.text: 帮我弄懂这段技术文档
say.note: 得到一份大白话的说明

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude explains technical material in plain English, breaking it down point by point by who, what, why, and related angles.
howto.when_en: Triggers when something reads too technical and you want a plain-English breakdown; the description states it's for when the user wants a plain-English explanation of something technical.

say_en.text: Explain this to me in plain English
say_en.note: It breaks it down point by point.

say_en.text: What is this error actually saying? Keep it simple.
Help me understand this technical doc
